reference.title: Health-app launch video
reference.notes: The best script of the set: hype, doubt, rules, verdict, learning. Black and cream alternate as the pacing device and one green accent always lands on the key word; punctuation beats (a slot-mask verdict pill, a liquid wave wipe, dust into the logo) are tasteful and earned. Studied from what the page shows publicly; rebuilt in Moovi's own code (packages/library/src/kits/launch) with our own fonts, sounds and assets.

parts.name: Last word drops, underline draws
parts.about: the line rises; its last word drops in late on a spring and a hand-drawn underline writes itself under it

parts.name: Liquid wave wipe
parts.about: a band of the next world rises with a travelling double sine edge and reveals the next shot

parts.name: Feature chip
parts.about: a white chip with a line icon and a feature name, springing in, gaining an accent outline when locked

parts.name: Phone
parts.about: a modern phone with an island, a status bar and a light along the rim, holding the real mobile site shot

parts.name: Dotted progress
parts.about: a row of rounded cells that fill in the accent, one by one

parts.name: Line chart draws
parts.about: a line draws left to right with a travelling end dot and a soft area under it

parts.name: Split worlds
parts.about: the frame divided by a seam into two shades of the world (two worlds in one shot)

parts.name: Hype burst
parts.about: a one-off burst of thin radial streaks behind the subject on a hit (the hype opener), once a film at most

parts.role: the hype open: everyone swears it works
parts.name: Crowd claim fly-through
parts.about: a stream of two-tone capsules, scored tablets, crosses and star rows flies out of a vanishing point past the lens around a centred claim; at the end everything implodes into one accent dot

parts.role: turns everyone into you and hands the dot on
parts.name: Question with a seed dot
parts.about: a centred question over the out-of-focus product, the viewer's word in the accent; the accent dot pops out of that word and travels to the centre while the lines pinch shut

parts.name: Mark beside the statement
parts.about: the accent dot slides over and swells into the mark (accent to ink), the statement lands beside it, its last word gets a hand-drawn underline, then the mark splits open

parts.role: the rules are set up front
parts.name: Rules sealed with a lock
parts.about: glass rule chips with icon badges slide in sheared, one per beat, under the line; an accent outline draws around them from the top centre both ways and a padlock snaps into the gap

parts.name: One tap builds a streak
parts.about: the line and an accent action pill on the left; a tap sends a ring across the frame that reveals a big phone with a habit grid; day tiles fly out of the grid, spinning, into a streak bar

parts.name: Verdict slot drum
parts.about: the line over a wide dark window that spins a drum of outcome pills with ghost smear and dimmed neighbours; it slows on decelerating ticks and lands on one with a settle and a glow ring

parts.role: the drop: the verdict is real, it is in the app
parts.name: Match cut into the app
parts.about: the outcome badge inside the phone's result screen fills the frame at 5x on the cut, a focus ring blooms off it, then the camera pulls all the way back to the phone and the line lands beside it

parts.name: Stat beside the phone
parts.about: the line and a huge accent number counting up on the left, the phone with its result on the right; the phone's chart then lifts out of the device, draws across the frame and settles big under the number with a wash band

parts.role: shows the change instead of saying it
parts.name: Before/after step chart
parts.about: a jittery accent line runs across the whole frame, passes a wash band, steps down and stays lower, with a dashed before guide, a dotted after guide and the change in an accent pill on the step

parts.role: it learns, then picks the next one
parts.name: Branch picker graph
parts.about: a done root node with a check fans curved edges to candidate pills that pop in; dots flow along the edges, a selection ring hops between candidates on the eighths, then commits: the chosen fills in the accent and its edge thickens

parts.name: Dust re-forms a glyph
parts.about: square dust swirls across a black frame, balls up, opens into a ring, settles into the outline of the line's first letter, fills in solid and shrinks into the line itself

parts.name: Split mark lockup
parts.about: the seed dot pops in, swells into the mark and splits open; the wordmark rises from a mask under it and the address fades in last, over the out-of-focus product

parts.role: the line collapses into the logo
parts.name: Wordmark squeezes into the mark
parts.about: the wordmark's letters slide into the first letter, which collapses into the dot; the dot swells into the mark, splits, and the wordmark returns small under it with the address

parts.name: Depth word stack
parts.about: words arrive ten a second from in front of the lens, bigger, grey and soft, and snap to size and colour; a centred line re-centres as it grows

parts.name: Tumbling word drop
parts.about: each word drops in from below-right, tilted about ten degrees and half transparent, and springs flat; the accent word lands last

parts.name: Tracking collapse
parts.about: the line appears spaced wide and soft and condenses to tight tracking, like a held breath

parts.name: Pinch-in with accent flood
parts.about: alternate lines close in from opposite sides of their masks, then the accent word floods into colour with a tiny swell

parts.name: Grey settle
parts.about: words rise in grey one by one and settle to ink a beat later, the accent word settling to the accent

parts.role: the crowd collapses into one and the question opens from it
parts.name: Implode to a dot, iris out
parts.about: the shot swirls and shrinks into its exit point until only the accent dot is left, then the next world opens out of that dot in an accelerating circle

parts.role: through the mark onto the rules board
parts.name: Fly through the gap
parts.about: a slow creep, then the camera rushes in log space (about 9x) into the exit point, the gap in the split mark, and lands on the next shot settling from 106%

parts.name: Stack merges into a pill
parts.about: the outgoing group of cards loses its text, tints to the accent and cascades up-left in an arc into one pill that lands on the next shot's button

parts.role: the tap that brings in the app
parts.name: Tap ring reveal
parts.about: a soft press at the hand-off point, then a thin ring races out past the frame edge with the next shot inside it

parts.role: from the proof world into the black verdict
parts.name: Ink pour curtain
parts.about: a sheet of the next world pours down over the shot with a slow two-lobe liquid edge and a soft shadow, like poured ink

parts.role: the drop: from the verdict pill to the same pill in the app
parts.name: Token match zoom
parts.about: the next shot opens at 6x on the same token the last shot ended on, a focus ring blooms, the camera holds with a drift and pulls all the way back

parts.role: the result becomes the start of the next test
parts.name: Squeeze to a dot
parts.about: the shot is squeezed from both sides into a squiggle and then a dot at its exit point; the dot arcs to the next shot's entry and the next shot opens out of it

parts.role: everything turns to dust and returns to one
parts.name: Dust black hole
parts.about: the shot breaks into square dust that drifts outward and swirls while a disc opens from its exit point and swallows the frame with the next shot inside

parts.role: sets up the fly-through of the mark
parts.name: Creep, then rush
parts.about: a slow creep through the beat, then an exponential push into the beat's exit point in its last third of a second

parts.role: from the token to the device
parts.name: Close-up pull-back
parts.about: the beat opens tight (3x) on its entry token with a drift, then pulls all the way back to the whole shot

parts.role: what one tap a day builds
parts.name: Habit grid phone
parts.about: a phone app with an adherence ring, x of y days, a week grid where done days are accent squares and today is outlined, two actions, a trend card and a tab bar; the grid fills live

parts.name: Dotted streak bar
parts.about: a row of small rounded squares builds left to right ending in an outlined goal box; squares pop solid accent one by one as progress lands

parts.name: Skew-in glass chips
parts.about: glass rule chips with a tinted icon badge slide in from the left sheared and soft, then straighten; the stack re-centres on a spring each time

parts.name: Outline lock seal
parts.about: an accent outline draws around a group from the top centre in both directions and a padlock pops into the gap and snaps shut

parts.name: Verdict drum
parts.about: a dark rounded window spinning a vertical drum of outcome pills with motion ghosts; it slows and lands on the target with a settle and a glow ring, neighbours dimmed and narrower

parts.name: Serif result screen
parts.about: a phone result page set in a text serif: a caps label, a two-line headline, an outcome card with a mint badge, a chart card and a details row

parts.name: Step chart with band
parts.about: a jittery accent line that runs high, passes a wash band, steps down and stays lower, with dashed and dotted guides

parts.name: Hopping selection ring
parts.about: an outline ring hops from option to option as if weighing them, then commits: the chosen fills in the accent, the rest fade

parts.role: the board the rules are set on
parts.name: Quiet paper grid
parts.about: a soft 80-unit grid on the paper, every fourth line a touch stronger, fading out toward the edges

parts.name: Capsule confetti stream
parts.about: a lighter stream of capsules, tablets, crosses and star rows flying past the lens over a hype beat

uses.role: headline and confetti implode into the seed dot
cream iris blooms from the seed dot
hand-drawn underline under the last word
fly through the gap of the mark
the action line typed with a caret
the press on the action pill
the phone carrying the app screens
the phone frame every screen sits in
ghost smear on the spinning drum
pull back from the in-app pill to the phone
the number counts up with one decimal
words land grey and turn ink
the commit pulse on the chosen candidate
a breath on the long holds
